doc: PROFILE.md 5.1, `readers.ptx`: "`readers.ptx` takes the fourth column of a PTX row as a reflectance in [0,1] and scales it into `Intensity` by 4096, not by 65535: reflectance 0.5 reads back as `Intensity` 2048." -- the shipped page stages/readers.ptx.rst states only that the reader 'infers dimensions from points stored in a text file' and names no scale, so the factor is stated in the profile and that is where a reader finds it. The three real rows 0.5, 0.25 and 0.75 therefore come out as 2048, 1024 and 3072 -- one intensity per row, in the order the rows are written, so Intensity 3072 belongs to the point at (7,8,9).
